blocks.title: Na deze pdf kun je
bullets: inversie gebruiken na ontkennende en beperkende woorden (Never have I seen ...)
voorwaardelijke zinnen zonder if maken (Had I known ...)
nadruk leggen met gespleten zinnen (What I need is ...)

blocks.text: In formeel en literair Engels kun je een zin beginnen met een ontkennend of beperkend woord. Dan volgt een vraagvolgorde: hulpwerkwoord vóór het onderwerp.

head: Begin
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: Never
Never have I seen such a mess.
Nog nooit heb ik zo'n rommel gezien.
Rarely / Seldom
Rarely do we get such good weather.
Zelden hebben we zulk mooi weer.
Not only ... but also
Not only is it cheap, but it's also fast.
Het is niet alleen goedkoop, maar ook snel.
Hardly ... when
Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain.
Ik was nauwelijks aangekomen of het begon te regenen.
No sooner ... than
No sooner had we left than the phone rang.
We waren net weg toen de telefoon ging.
Under no circumstances
Under no circumstances should you open this door.
Onder geen beding mag je deze deur openen.
Only then / Only when
Only then did I understand.
Pas toen begreep ik het.
Little
Little did she know what was coming.
Ze had geen idee wat er ging gebeuren.

blocks.title: Hier lijkt het Engels op het Nederlands
blocks.text: Het Nederlands keert altijd om na een woord vooraan: Nooit heb ik .... Het Engels doet dat alleen na deze ontkennende woorden, en gebruikt een hulpwerkwoord: Never have I, Rarely do we. Na gewone woorden als yesterday blijft de volgorde normaal (zie A1 · pdf 8).

head: Met inversie (formeel)
Gewoon
rows: Had I known, I would have come.
If I had known, I would have come.
Were I in your position, I would resign.
If I were in your position, I would resign.
Should you need help, call this number.
If you need help, call this number.

head: Patroon
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: It is / was ... that / who
It was Tom who broke the window.
Het was Tom die het raam brak.
What ... is / was
What I need is a holiday.
Wat ik nodig heb, is vakantie.
All ... is / was
All I want is some peace.
Het enige wat ik wil, is wat rust.
The thing / reason ... is
The reason I'm late is that I missed the bus.
De reden dat ik te laat ben, is dat ik de bus miste.
What happened was
What happened was that the car broke down.
Wat er gebeurde, was dat de auto kapotging.

blocks.text: In een bevestigende zin kun je do, does of did toevoegen om iets te benadrukken of tegen te spreken: I do like your dress! (Ik vind je jurk echt mooi.) She did call you; you just didn't hear it. Do sit down. (Gaat u toch zitten.)

rows: Never I have seen this.
Never have I seen this.
Na never vooraan: inversie.
Rarely we go out.
Rarely do we go out.
Inversie met do.
Not only it is cheap, but also fast.
Not only is it cheap, but it is also fast.
Na not only: inversie.
No sooner we had left when it rained.
No sooner had we left than it rained.
No sooner had ... than.
What I need it is a rest.
What I need is a rest.
Geen extra it.
If I would have known, I would have come.
Had I known, I would have come.
Formeel zonder if: Had I known.
I do liked it.
I did like it.
Na did: kaal werkwoord.

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.full: Never have I heard such nonsense.

items.q: Rarely ______ we see snow in this area.
items.full: Rarely do we see snow in this area.

items.q: Not only ______ she clever, but she is also kind.
items.full: Not only is she clever, but she is also kind.

items.q: No sooner had I sat down ______ the phone rang.
items.full: No sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.

items.q: ______ I known, I would have helped.
items.full: Had I known, I would have helped.

items.q: ______ you have any questions, please contact us.
items.full: Should you have any questions, please contact us.

items.q: ______ I need is a long holiday.
items.full: What I need is a long holiday.

items.q: It was my sister ______ told me the news.
items.full: It was my sister who told me the news.

items.q: Only then ______ I realise my mistake.
items.full: Only then did I realise my mistake.
I do remember locking the door!

items.q: Nog nooit heb ik zoiets gezien.
items.a: Never have I seen anything like it.

items.q: Wat ik nodig heb, is rust.
Het was Tom die het raam brak.
items.a: It was Tom who broke the window.

items.q: Had ik het maar geweten, dan was ik gekomen.
items.a: Had I known, I would have come.
